caption: The drawing is a sampler-style embroidery featuring an arrangement of various objects and plants stitched onto a tan or cream-colored fabric background. At the upper left, there is a rectangular, two-story yellow house with five white windows and a white door, set upon a small terrace with steps. Just above the house, the alphabet is stitched in block letters using blue and brown thread, followed by a row with a name and date in brownish text. Occupying the central and upper portions of the composition are large, stylized flowers in vases or rooted in the ground, rendered in green, red, pink, and blue thread. Among the flowers, there are birds, some red and others in brown or tan, perched on stems or scattered throughout. Below the house and flowers, there is a section featuring geometric and floral decorative patterns, with symmetrical arrangements of flowers, birds, and potted plants. At the lower right, distinct from the rest, is a rectangular section with a simple peacock figure stitched in tan and yellow, its tail decorated with red accents. The entire composition is surrounded by a narrow plain border, with no additional framing. The color palette consists primarily of green, red, blue, yellow, pink, tan, and white stitches on the neutral fabric ground.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
